_note: Places never sent to Gemini for snorkeling & diving, decided 2026-10-09: nothing underwater is worth seeing within a day trip (three hours each way): landlocked or far-inland places with no sea, reef, lake, spring or flooded cave that anyone dives or snorkels for. Places with a notable freshwater draw or a coast within reach (for example Banff's Lake Minnewanka, Chicago's Lake Michigan wrecks, Texas Hill Country springs, the Pantanal's clear rivers around Bonito, Swiss and Bavarian lakes) are deliberately NOT here, so Gemini decides them. All are already marked N/A. Used by gemini-author-batch.ts --skip-clear-na.
